high_level_description: This image captures a celebratory moment at what appears to be a graduation ceremony. The setting is indoors, with a backdrop featuring the words "Warwick Celebrates" prominently displayed on a purple screen. The screen also includes the Warwick University logo, indicating that the event is taking place at the University of Warwick. In the foreground, two women are posing for the photo. The woman on the right is wearing a graduation gown and cap, signifying her recent graduation. She is holding a certificate and a bouquet of flowers wrapped in clear paper with floral arrangements inside.
